meta.title: 8️⃣个假期姐妹见面吃饭拍照姿势！小幅度～
meta.title_en: 8 Small-Move Dining Poses for Sister Meetups
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 吃饭姿势

scenes.title_cn: 举杯错位喝 + 托腮秀美甲
scenes.context: 现在不比耶了，我们比的是小幅度动作。举杯错位喝：一前一后，有层次感；长脸展示美甲：托腮侧脸秀美甲。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 现在不比耶了，我们比小幅度动作。
No more peace signs — we compare small, subtle moves.
subtle moves（小幅度动作）
举杯错位喝，一前一后，有层次感。
Lift glasses and drink off-beat — one front, one back, layered.
drink off-beat（错位喝）；layered（有层次感）
托腮侧脸，展示美甲。
Chin on hand, turn the profile, show off the nails.
show off the nails（展示美甲）
paraphrase: 小幅度 → small moves / subtle gestures
scenes.speak: No more peace signs — we compare small, subtle moves. Lift glasses and drink off-beat — one front, one back, layered. Chin on hand, turn the profile, show off the nails.

scenes.title_en: Biting a Straw and the Dig-In Moment
scenes.context: 夹根吸管咬住看镜头，俏皮可爱；开动瞬间抓拍，有生活感。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 夹根吸管咬住，看镜头，俏皮。
Bite a straw and look at the lens — playful.
bite a straw（咬吸管）；playful（俏皮）
开动的瞬间抓拍，有生活感。
Catch the moment you start digging in — that's the everyday feel.
digging in（开动）；everyday feel（生活感）
动作不用大，自然就好。
The moves don't need to be big — natural is enough.
natural is enough（自然就好）
paraphrase: 开动 → dig in / start eating
生活感 → everyday feel / candid charm
scenes.speak: Bite a straw and look at the lens — playful. Catch the moment you start digging in — that's the everyday feel. The moves don't need to be big — natural is enough.

scenes.title_cn: 一起委屈脸 + 吃烤串互动
scenes.title_en: Duo Pout Faces and Skewer Interaction
scenes.context: 双人合影：一起委屈脸，有表情互动；吃烤串互动，举着烤串拍照。语域：拍照教学，双人姿势口令。
sentences: 一起委屈脸，双人表情合影。
Make pout faces together — a duo expression shot.
pout faces（委屈脸）
吃烤串还可以这样，举着烤串拍照。
Grilled skewers work too — pose holding one up.
pose holding one up（举着烤串）
双人照的核心是互动感。
The heart of a duo shot is the interaction.
the interaction（互动感）
paraphrase: 委屈脸 → pout faces / pretend to sulk
scenes.speak: Make pout faces together — a duo expression shot. Grilled skewers work too — pose holding one up. The heart of a duo shot is the interaction.

scenes.title_cn: 展示美食 + 筷子框脸
scenes.title_en: Show the Food and Frame the Face With Chopsticks
scenes.context: 展示美食：食物入镜，画面更丰富；用筷子框住脸：显脸小又出片。语域：拍照教学，收尾动作。
sentences: 展示美食，让食物入镜。
Show the food and put the dish in frame.
put the dish in frame（食物入镜）
用筷子框住脸，显脸小又出片。
Frame your face with chopsticks — slimming and photogenic.
slimming and photogenic（显脸小又出片）
这8个小动作，姐妹聚会够用了。
These eight little moves cover any sister meetup.
cover any meetup（够用了）
paraphrase: 食物入镜 → put the dish in frame / show the food
scenes.speak: Show the food and put the dish in frame. Frame your face with chopsticks — slimming and photogenic. These eight little moves cover any sister meetup.

practice: Lift glasses and drink off-beat — one front, one back, layered.
Bite a straw and look at the lens — playful.
Make pout faces together — a duo expression shot.
Frame your face with chopsticks — slimming and photogenic.
pitfalls: No more peace signs — we compare small, subtle moves.
Drink off-beat — one front, one back.
「错位喝」用 drink off-beat，不是 drink wrongly。
Show the nails with long face.
Chin on hand, turn the profile, show off the nails.
「托腮侧脸」用 chin on hand, turn the profile。
Frame your face with chopsticks — slimming and photogenic.
「用筷子框住脸」用 frame your face with chopsticks。
shifts: 用 subtle moves（小幅度）、drink off-beat（错位喝）、duo expression shot（双人表情照）
用 pout faces（委屈脸）、playful（俏皮）、natural（自然）
用 interaction（互动感）、slimming（显脸小）、photogenic（出片）、everyday feel（生活感）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：比业→比耶、胡杰杰→举杯/互动、长脸→托腮、培根→开动/烤串、委屈脸、筷子框脸、错位喝、美甲等。
